title: Lifecycle State Machine
description: Refine `schemas/workorder.schema.json` to formally enumerate the `status` string property and define legal state transitions.

requirements.status_enum: Add `status` as a required property. Enum: OPEN, LEASED, BLOCKED, DONE, SEALED, FAILED, CANCELLED.

acceptance_criteria: The schema passes JSON draft-07 validation and rejects invalid statuses.
failure_modes: FAIL: Forgetting to add `status` to the `required` array.
